basic_info.description: Attention contractors and developers! This home is in disrepair and needs a significant renovation to unlock its full potential. With 2,600 sq ft of living space per tax records, the house currently includes formal living and dining rooms plus two bedrooms on the main level. The lower level has an enormous garage and yard access. Ideally located on a lovely block in Miraloma Park close to Tower Market shops and easy access to West Portal shopping and eateries, Mt. Davidson Park and its miles of hiking trails plus public/tech transportation and convenient freeway access. A true diamond in the rough! No preemptive offers. Offers welcome on Wed, Nov 20th at 10 AM.
